title: Flour from the Mill

readiness.math: sorting by kind; comparing weight: heavier, lighter, the same; big and small scoops (2 and 1)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: This is the mill. The river turns the big wheel, and the wheel turns the heavy stones that make flour.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: But first, the grain must be clean. The light, papery bits are called chaff. They don't belong in the bread.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.prompt: Put the grain in the sack, and the chaff in the basket.
steps.hint: Grain is round and golden. Chaff is light and flat.

feedback.mismatch: Look closely. Is that grain, or chaff?
feedback.all_good: All sorted! Clean grain, ready for the millstones.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.prompt: Now the grain is flour! Tobias needs a bag as heavy as his stone. Add scoops of flour until the beam is level.
steps.hint: Watch the beam. If the stone side is lower, add a scoop. If the flour side is lower, take one out. A little scoop helps you get it just right.

feedback.heavy: Now the flour side is lower. It's too heavy. Take one scoop out.
feedback.all_good: The beam is level! The flour weighs the same as the stone.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Just right! The flour goes to Tobias. Tomorrow, it will become bread.

journal_line: I helped at the mill. I sorted the grain from the chaff, and weighed the flour until the scale was level.
unavailable_text: The flour is ready for Tobias. The millstones are resting.
